# ci-coverage-baseline.txt — the reviewed allow-list of test suites that are known
# to run in NO workflow (or are deliberately excluded), consumed by

# phase C, executing the deferred Phase 8.1/8.3 of blob-cas-remediation.md).

# This is the ratchet's shrinking allow-list: every entry here is a gap the audit
# surfaced that C2 has not yet closed. Each suite either gets wired into a workflow and
# its line removed, or stays here with a filed reason. The check FAILS if a now-covered
# or deleted entry is left here, so the list can only shrink.
#
# Format: one item id per line, then `# <reason>`. Reason tags:
#   C2:needs-nothing / C2:needs-ffi / C2:needs-docker — setup class (all now wired
#   except the entry below); PARITY:<pair> — cross-runtime pair member (all 7 pairs
#   now fully covered on both runtimes, none remain here).
#

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DEFERRED — needs multi-process orchestration, not just a container. Filed follow-up.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# S3DirectMinioEndToEndTests is not a self-contained testcontainers test: it requires a
# SEPARATELY-LAUNCHED dotnet S3-direct origin host (bound to :7979 with the full
# NODALMERGE_S3_* config) AND a MinIO bucket, then reads NODALMERGE_TEST_S3DIRECT_ORIGIN_BASEURL
# to find that origin. With the env unset it prints a message and returns — a vacuous pass
# (verified: 11ms, no container). Wiring it honestly needs a workflow that stands up MinIO,
# builds+launches the S3-direct host as a background process, exports the base URL, runs the
# test, and tears both down. That orchestration can't be validated locally with confidence and
# is deferred as its own slice (follow-up filed). Until then it stays baselined rather than
# wired-then-vacuously-green. The rust blob_url_resolution_minio.rs above already gives real
# MinIO coverage of the same /url + /uploaded routes through the axum router.
dotnet:NodalMerge.DotNetHost.Tests.S3DirectMinioEndToEndTests                       # C2:needs-docker+host-process (deferred — multi-process orchestration; see note above)
